If you’d like to retrieve those IDs yourself, you can use the VirusTotal DNS lookup endpoint:

```
GET https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/sample.com/dns
Authorization: Bearer secret123
```

The response will include a list of DNS records, each with an `id` field. Those `id` values are the object IDs you’re looking for.
